punchline: Dan Harris's pitch for meditation was refreshingly unimpressive: it makes you about 10% happier.
thirty_sec: People kept asking Dan Harris, a skeptical news anchor, why he meditated. His answer: it made him about 10% happier. He chose that small number on purpose, because he didn't trust self-help promises of total transformation. Meditation didn't erase his anxiety or his anger. It helped him notice them and respond instead of just reacting. That honest, modest claim became the title of his book.
question: What's one small, real improvement in your life you're quietly proud of?
